name: Mint
copy: The most cohesive fit for the current site. The mint accent keeps the globe, project illustrations, and navigation in the same visual language.

name: Cobalt
copy: A navy background and pale blue accents. A quieter alternative with clear text contrast, though less distinctive than Mint or New York.

name: Paper
copy: Warm paper, charcoal text, and rust accents. Comfortable for reading the longer case studies; the technical illustrations keep their original colors.

name: New York
copy: The strongest personal direction. Transit colors, bold type, route markers, and a skyline connect the portfolio to life at NYU and in New York.
